page_subtitle: Your personal keys for workspace access (MCP search and indexing). A key value is only shown at creation.
empty: No API keys. Create one and pick the workspaces it can access.
revoke_confirm_body: The key becomes immediately invalid on all its workspaces. Irreversible action.
create_dialog_desc: Name the key, then pick the accessible workspaces and their permissions.
created_key_warning: This key will never be shown again. Copy it before closing.
rotate_confirm: A new key will be generated with the same access. The old one stays valid for 72 hours.

grants.title: Accessible workspaces
grants.help: READ allows search (MCP); WRITE allows push indexing.

mcp_token_hint: Access token → one of your API keys (API keys page), with READ permission on this workspace
keys_moved_body: Access keys are now personal and managed in Configuration → API keys. Grant them this workspace with READ (search) and/or WRITE (indexing).

mcp.title: Connect an MCP client
mcp.subtitle: Standard HTTP (Streamable) transport. Copy the endpoint and header, or the ready-to-paste config block for your client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop…).
mcp.no_read_grant: This key has no read access to any workspace: MCP search requires the “read” grant. Add one via “Edit access”.
mcp.placeholder_note: A key's value is shown only at creation: replace <VOTRE_CLÉ_API> with yours.
mcp.dialog_desc: Settings to wire an MCP client to this key.
